description: Defines an abstract collection class 'DocumentObjectCollection' for the MigraDoc Document Object Model, implementing collection management, cloning, copying, and visitor pattern support.

classes.name: DocumentObjectCollection
classes.description: An abstract collection class managing a list of DocumentObject instances, supporting cloning, copying, insertion, removal, and visitor pattern.

methods.name: Clone
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of the collection.

methods.name: DeepCopy
methods.description: Performs a deep copy of the collection and its elements.

methods.name: CopyTo
methods.description: Copies collection elements to an array starting at a specified index.

methods.name: Clear
methods.description: Removes all elements and resets cached values.

methods.name: InsertObject
methods.description: Inserts a DocumentObject at a specified index and updates parent and cached values.

methods.name: IndexOf
methods.description: Returns the index of a specified DocumentObject.

methods.name: this[int]
methods.description: Gets or sets the element at a specified index.

methods.name: LastObject
methods.description: Returns the last element or null if empty.

methods.name: RemoveObjectAt
methods.description: Removes element at specified index and updates cached values.

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Adds a DocumentObject to the collection and updates parent and cached values.

methods.name: IsNull
methods.description: Checks if the collection is null or all elements are null.

methods.name: SetNull
methods.description: Clears the collection, setting it to null state.
